stokes_brinkman_pde.operator: eta * nabla^2 v + eta_b * nabla(nabla . v) - xi * v = -nabla . sigma_a
stokes_brinkman_pde.fourier_symbol: L_{ij}(k) = (eta * |k|^2 + xi) * delta_{ij} + eta_b * k_i * k_j
stokes_brinkman_pde.hydrodynamic_length_um: ell_H = sqrt(eta / xi) = 180.0 um (range 100-300 um across vitelline friction regimes)
stokes_brinkman_pde.description: Overdamped 2D compressible viscous Stokes-Brinkman balance on the cartographic blastoderm surface M. Long-range hydrodynamic screening length ell_H = sqrt(eta/xi) ~ 180 um couples ventrolateral DV myosin cable contraction and posterior midgut invagination into a global 4-vortex embryonic flow field.

active_nematic_myosin_stress_tensor.formula: sigma^a_{ij}(x) = alpha_iso * m_iso(x) * delta_{ij} + alpha_aniso * m_aniso(x) * Q_{ij}(x)
active_nematic_myosin_stress_tensor.nematic_tensor: Q_{ij} = n_i * n_j - 0.5 * delta_{ij}, Tr(Q) = Q_{xx} + Q_{yy} = 0
active_nematic_myosin_stress_tensor.description: Trace-free active nematic stress tensor Q_{ij} aligned with dorsoventral (DV) junctional Myosin-II cables (Q_{yy} = +0.5 > 0, Q_{xx} = -0.5 < 0) generates simultaneous DV convergence (dv_y/dy < 0) and AP germband extension (dv_x/dx > 0), while isotropic apical myosin in the posterior midgut (PMG) primordium drives tissue sink compression (nabla . v < 0).

streichan_2018_experimental_regimes.section: Streichan et al. (2018) eLife 7:e27454 Figs. 2-5; Lefebvre et al. (2023) eLife 12:e78787 Figs. 2-4

regimes.label: Wild-Type GBE (DV Anisotropic Myosin Cables + Isotropic PMG Invagination, Streichan 2018 Fig. 2)
DV Anisotropic Myosin Cables Only (No Isotropic PMG Invagination Sink, alpha_iso=0)
twist / snail Ventral Mesoderm Mutant (Preserved Ectodermal DV Cables + PMG Sink, Streichan 2018 Fig. 4)
Isotropic Myosin Assumption (alpha_aniso=0, Streichan 2018 Fig. 2 Null Tensor Test)
even-skipped (eve) Pair-Rule Mutant (Severely Reduced DV Myosin Anisotropy, Streichan 2018 Fig. 4)
bcd nos tsl Maternal AP-Null Triple Mutant (Zero DV Anisotropy & Zero PMG Flow, Streichan 2018 Fig. 4)
